Please provide code and sessionInfo() showing how you generated that
"information". I assume you refer to a regions file generated by one
of the segmentation models. But basically, each row is a region as
identified by the segmentation method. The columns are:

sample: The name of the sample containing the region.
chromosome, start, stop: The chromosome and the start and stop
positions (nucleotide position starting at postion 1) of the region.
mean: The mean raw CN of all loci in the region. (This is typically
the mean of the log2 ratios.)
count: The number of loci (at which there are data points) in the region.
url: A URL to the UCSC Genome Browser showing thethe region +/- some
margins. This is hardwired to the human genome and current hg18.
There is no easy way to change the latter right now and only there for
your convenience, if it applies.

Cheers
